# Data Model

## AS IS - Current state

### Entities

| Entity | Core attributes | Relationships and invariants |
|---|---|---|
| User | name, type, role_id, unique email, verified_at, password, deleted_at | Optional `Role`; soft-deleted; password hidden/hashed; type cast to `TypeUsers` |
| Role | name, description | Has many users; permissions synchronized through `permission_role` |
| Permission | unique name, description | Many-to-many role assignment through the role permission behavior |
| Region | name | Has many states; no timestamps |
| State | name, initials, region_id | Belongs to region; has many cities; no timestamps |
| City | name, state_id, ibge_code | Belongs to state; has many addresses; no timestamps |
| Address | postal_code, street, district, number, complement, city_id | Belongs to city |
| Media | entity_type/id, name, original_name, collection, type, disk, size | Polymorphic entity; path is `{collection}/{name}` |
| SystemErrorAlert | fingerprint, status, severity, environment, exception/request context, occurrences, timestamps | Optional user; indexed by fingerprint/environment and status/severity |
| CommandExecution | user snapshot, command/arguments, status, exit/output/duration, executed_at | Optional user; retained after user deletion via null FK |
| Notification | Laravel database notification fields | Application notification persistence |
| AgentConversation | AI conversation state | Schema defined by `2026_03_20_101853_create_agent_conversations_table.php` |

### Relationship map

```text
Role 1 --- * User
Role * --- * Permission
Region 1 --- * State 1 --- * City 1 --- * Address
User 1 --- * SystemErrorAlert
User 1 --- * CommandExecution
Model 1 --- * Media (polymorphic)
```

### Storage

- Eloquent models map to relational tables created under `database/migrations/`.
- The default database connection is selected by `DB_CONNECTION`; `config/database.php` contains the supported Laravel connection definitions.
- Laravel migrations are the schema migration tool; factories under `database/factories/` provide test data.
- Sessions, password-reset tokens, personal access tokens, audits, jobs, failed jobs, and job batches use dedicated tables.

### Cache

- Laravel cache stores application cache and lock rows when the database driver is selected (`0001_01_01_000001_create_cache_table.php`).
- Redis is configured through Predis and used by Horizon queues.
- `DiscordAlert` stores `alerts:discord:{fingerprint}` throttle keys and queue diagnostic snapshots under `alerts:queue:last-job:database:{queue}`.
